title: Phone: Red Cross at Brandt Lake HS — "Is There a List?" + TAC 3 Transit Bus Relay

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Highway 21 Command Post, PIO Mobile

caller.name: Denise Harwood
caller.label: American Red Cross Shelter Lead, Brandt Lake High School Reunification Center

transcript.speaker: PIO
transcript.text: LCEMS PIO, go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Red Cross
transcript.text: This is Denise Harwood, Red Cross, at the high school gym. I need help. The call-in line, 920-555-0195, has sixty calls waiting and I have two volunteers on it. Two. People are holding for twenty minutes and then hanging up and calling the hospitals instead.

transcript.speaker: Red Cross
transcript.text: Every one of them wants a name. Is my wife there, is my dad there. The hospitals won't release names to us, and I've got nothing to tell them.

transcript.speaker: PIO
transcript.text: Understood. How many families are with you right now?

transcript.speaker: Red Cross
transcript.text: Fourteen family members in the gym. Three more drove to LRMC first, because that's what the TV said, and LRMC security sent them back here. They're not happy. One of them was at Pinecrest before that.

transcript.speaker: Red Cross
transcript.text: And here's the one that worries me. A mother is sitting at my table. She says her son, twenty-four, dark hoodie, was on the casino bus. He's not one of the seven green patients we have here. I walked her down the row myself. She's asking me if he's at a hospital, or still out there, or... she saw the picture with the tarp.

transcript.speaker: Red Cross
transcript.text: So, is there a list? Anything. Tag numbers, ages, which hospital. I don't need it for the public. I need it so my people can match a description and stop guessing.

transcript.speaker: PIO
transcript.text: I hear you. Stay on with me a second.

transcript.speaker: Red Cross
transcript.text: Also, nobody from the Sheriff's victim services is here yet. It's me, four paramedics for the injured, and volunteers. If more families show up I'm out of chairs and out of people.

transcript.speaker: Radio, LARK TAC 3
transcript.text: Highway 21 Command, Medical Group, Larkfield. Relay from Larkfield County Transit dispatch. The second transit bus for your four green patients is stopped behind the State Patrol closure at County Road K. Driver's ETA is now 20:30. Driver is asking which way you want him to come in.

transcript.speaker: Red Cross
transcript.text: Was that the bus for my site? Tell me when to expect them. I'll hold.

voiceStyles.PIO: Calm adult, outdoors at a command post, rain on a vehicle roof, generator hum
voiceStyles.Red Cross: Woman in her 50s, organized but stretched thin, gymnasium echo, phones ringing and voices behind her
voiceStyles.Radio, LARK TAC 3: Telecommunicator, even and clipped, heard through a portable radio speaker near the phone

instructorNote: This inject tests whether reunification and patient flow stay consistent. Watch for three things. First, the PIO should send families only to the reunification center and the call-in line, and ask the Red Cross and the Sheriff's victim services for more call takers (MCI Plan 7). Second, the PIO should get a patient list from the Medical Group by tag, age and sex for the reunification staff only, not for the public. Third, the IC and Medical Group should work with the State Patrol to bring the transit bus through the closure, keep the four Minor patients out of the rain, and send them to the minor injury site, not to a hospital.
